name: QifSift — QIF/QBO/QFX/OFX to CSV Converter with Duplicate Flags & Balance Re-Check (Local, Private)
description:
My bank gives me QIF — how do I convert it to CSV without just trusting that the numbers survived the trip? Your bookkeeping tool wants CSV. Your credit union only offers QBO, and the converter you found sells each format as a separate $39.99 product — then leaves you to trust that the numbers survived the trip.
QifSift converts all four bank download formats — QIF, QBO, QFX and OFX — into one clean CSV on your own computer, and then RE-PARSES the file it wrote to prove the conversion: row count and net total must match the source exactly.
WHAT IT NORMALIZES
• Dates to ISO format — including Quicken's apostrophe years (03/16'26 becomes 2026-03-16) and OFX timezone suffixes
• Amounts to plain numbers — thousands separators removed, exact decimal arithmetic, no float drift
WHAT IT FLAGS INSTEAD OF HIDING
• Suspected duplicates — repeated FITIDs and exact date+amount+payee repeats are listed in the report and KEPT in the CSV. Deleting money records is your decision, not a tool's.
• Out-of-scope content — QIF investment sections are reported and skipped, never guessed at.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
On seeded test files with planted defects: a QIF carrying an apostrophe-year date, a comma amount and an exact duplicate converted to 4 rows totalling 1083.56 (duplicate flagged, investment section warned and skipped); a QBO with a timezone date and a repeated FITID converted to 3 rows totalling 1199.06. Both re-checks: PASS.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload, no account, no subscription. Your bank statement is the last file that should travel.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed. You get transactions.csv and the conversion report.
